|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else" | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal" | Flavour and sensation description. It makes no digestive or health promise, so it is fine as written |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted |

**Other checks**
- No numbers, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials or review counts.
- No health, money, legal or environmental claims. "After a big meal" describes when it tastes good, not a benefit to digestion. Don't extend it to "aids digestion" or "settles your stomach", as that would need proof and would likely trip platform policy.
- Slop-guard: no banned words, no em-dash sandwiches, no exclamation points, no rhetorical openers, no abstract triads. The opening is a plain product name, and the copy is concrete.
- Product-page consistency: the page needs nothing else to support these claims.

Nothing needs changing, so it is fine to publish.
